title: Jungle Potion
start: Speak to Trufitus near Tai Bwo Wannai.

recommended.t: 6 Tai Bwo Wannai Teleport scrolls, which teleport you right outside Trufitus Shakaya's house. Use one to arrive and one every time you find a herb.
Energy potion, mint cake, explorer's ring, and/or weight-reducing clothing, as you will be doing a lot of running during this quest.

kills.t: Able to defend against level 57 jogres, level 60 wandering warriors, and level 63 Harpie Bug Swarms

rewards.t: Access to Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup minigame
Access to use Rionasta for parcel service
Access to a gardener for calquat trees

steps.t: Talk to Trufitus in his house located northeast of Tai Bwo Wannai. [Chat: 3 It's a nice village, but where is everyone? › 1 Me? How can I help? › Accept]
Head south-west to some marshy jungle vines (refer to map).
p: Marshy jungle vines containing snake weed

steps.t: Search one for a grimy snake weed.

sub.t: Take three if you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters.

steps.t: Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean snake weed. [Chat: 1 Of course!]
Head north-east to some palm trees (refer to map).
Search one for a grimy ardrigal.

sub.t: Take two if you intend to do Legends' Quest.

steps.t: Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean ardrigal. [Chat: 1 Of course!]
Head south of Tai Bwo Wannai to the scorched earth near two fires (refer to map labelled "sito foil").
p: A lump of mud containing Sito foil.

steps.t: Search it for a grimy sito foil.
Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean sito foil. [Chat: 1 Of course!]
Head south-east to the mine.
Search the green-coloured rocks for a grimy volencia moss.
Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean volencia moss. [Chat: 1 Of course!]
Head back north near the palm trees and follow the shoreline west to some rocks (refer to map labelled "rogue's purse").
Search the rocks to enter the cave [Chat: 1 Yes, I'll enter the cave.] and ignore the level 57 jogres.

sub.t: (Optional) Kill one jogre to complete one of the easy Karamja achievements, It's a Jungle Ogre.

p: Rogue's purse is growing on the cave wall.

steps.t: Search a fungus covered Cavern wall for a grimy rogue's purse.

sub.t: Take two if you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters.

steps.t: Clean the herb.
Talk to Trufitus to give him a clean rogue's purse. [Chat: 1 Of course!]
Quest complete!

p: Palm trees with ardrigal at the base
